ranking_methodology.dynasty: 65% blended market dynasty value + 20% age-adjusted market value + 15% recent 8-week PPG (position-normalized). Market value = 50/50 blend of FantasyCalc and KeepTradeCut when both exist, else whichever source has a value. Youth bonus (+3) for age<=23 with market value > 50.
ranking_methodology.winnow: 55% blended market redraft value + 25% last-8-week PPG + 10% offensive snap share + 10% target share (position-normalized). Market value blends FantasyCalc and KeepTradeCut as above.
